annotations.title: Log in with an emailed code

description: Get an API key for an existing Gridline account with no browser, or renew an expiring one. Call with email only to email the user a 6-digit code; get it from their inbox if you can read it, or ask the user, then call again with email and code. The key is saved privately on this machine and never shown. Free.
name: email_login
title: Log in with an emailed code
